name: Agent CA Election Status Advice V 01
definition: Scope|This message is sent by an issuer (or its agent) to the CSD to report the status, or a change in status, of:|- a corporate action election advice;|- an election cancellation request; or|- an election amendment request.|Usage|This message must be sent in response to an:|- Agent Corporation Action Election Advice to provide the status of an election advice in the case of a rejection. However, it may also be used in all other situations, in which case, the building blocks Election Advice Identification and the Election Advice Status must be present.|- Agent Corporation Action Election Cancellation Request to provide the status of the cancellation request, in which case, the building blocks Election Cancellation Request Identification and the Election Cancellation Request Status must be present.|- Agent Corporation Action Election Amendment Request to provide the status of the amendment request, in which case, the building blocks Election Amendment Request Identification and the Election Amendment Request Status must be present.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification assigned by the Sender to unambiguously identify the status advice.

AgentCAElectionAdviceIdentification.name: Agent CA Election Advice Identification
AgentCAElectionAdviceIdentification.definition: Identification of the linked Agent CA Election Advice for which a status is given.

AgentCAElectionCancellationRequestIdenti.name: Agent CA Election Cancellation Request Identification
AgentCAElectionCancellationRequestIdenti.definition: Identification of the linked Agent CA Election Cancellation Request for which a status is given.

AgentCAElectionAmendmentRequestIdentific.name: Agent CA Election Amendment Request Identification
AgentCAElectionAmendmentRequestIdentific.definition: Identification of the linked Agent CA Election Amendment Request for which a status is given.

CorporateActionGeneralInformation.name: Corporate Action General Information
CorporateActionGeneralInformation.definition: General information about the corporate action event.

ElectionAdviceStatus.name: Election Advice Status
ElectionAdviceStatus.definition: Status of the election advice sent by the CSD.

ElectionCancellationRequestStatus.name: Election Cancellation Request Status
ElectionCancellationRequestStatus.definition: Status of the election cancellation request sent by the CSD.

ElectionAmendmentRequestStatus.name: Election Amendment Request Status
ElectionAmendmentRequestStatus.definition: Status of the amendment request sent by the CSD.

ElectionAdviceIDOrElectionCancellationRe.definition: Either AgentCAElectionAdviceIdentification or AgentCAElectionCancellationRequestIdentification or AgentCAElectionAmendmentRequestIdentification must be present.
Either AgentCAElectionAdviceIdentification or AgentCAElectionCancellationRequestIdentification or AgentCAElectionAmendmentRequestIdentification must be present.
Either AgentCAElectionAdviceIdentification or AgentCAElectionCancellationRequestIdentification or AgentCAElectionAmendmentRequestIdentification must be present.

ElectionAdviceStatusOrCancellationReques.definition: Either ElectionAdviceStatus or ElectionCancellationRequestStatus or ElectionAmendmentRequestStatus must be present.
Either ElectionAdviceStatus or ElectionCancellationRequestStatus or ElectionAmendmentRequestStatus must be present.
Either ElectionAdviceStatus or ElectionCancellationRequestStatus or ElectionAmendmentRequestStatus must be present.

ElectionAdviceStatusRule.definition: If AgentCAElectionAdviceIdentification is present, then ElectionAdviceStatus must be present.

ElectionAmendmentRequestStatusRule.definition: If AgentCAElectionAmendmentRequestIdentification is present, then ElectionAmendmentRequestStatus must be present.

ElectionCancellationRequestStatusRule.definition: If AgentCAElectionCancellationRequestIdentification is present, then ElectionCancellationRequestStatus must be present.
